statement: A change a client proposes carries at most the platform's limits.maxChangeOperations operations (20,000 by default): a larger one is refused 400, naming the count and the limit, before any operation is authorized or applied. An apply and a rollback are not held to it: their operations are derived from a document, which the entry budgets bound (CTL-40). The control routes read at most the document cap and 2 MB (10 MB) of a request's body on WebMvc and WebFlux alike, and answer a larger one 400 without asking the control plane (`CTL-70`). Every other route, one that carries no document (simulate, explain, analyze, a change's steps, a rollback, break-glass), reads at most 64 KB, eight times the 8 KB a request's headers take on Spring Boot's servers by default, and refuses a larger body 400 before it is parsed (DR1-F-3).
